points.title: 艺术启蒙
points.description: 勒·柯布西耶出生于瑞士拉绍德封的一个钟表制造家庭。在这里，他接受了早期艺术教育，在艺术学院学习，师从查尔斯·拉普拉德(Charles L'Eplattenier)。这段时期他受到新艺术运动(Art Nouveau)的影响，开始探索艺术与建筑的关系。他早期创作了大量风景画和肖像画，并设计了第一座建筑——别墅施瓦茨(Villa Schwob)，这些建立了他对形式与功能的初步理解。
points.descriptionEn: Born in La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland, into a watchmaking family, Le Corbusier received his early artistic education at the local art school under Charles L'Eplattenier. During this period, he was influenced by Art Nouveau and began exploring the relationship between art and architecture. He created numerous landscape paintings and portraits and designed his first architectural work, Villa Schwob, establishing his early understanding of form and function.

points.title: 游学探索
points.description: 勒·柯布西耶开始了为期四年的欧洲游学之旅，先后访问了巴黎、柏林、维也纳和布拉格等地。在巴黎，他跟随奥古斯特·佩雷(Auguste Perret)学习钢筋混凝土技术；在柏林，他遇到了彼得·贝伦斯(Peter Behrens)，在那里遇到了格罗皮乌斯和密斯·凡·德·罗；在维也纳，他接触到阿道夫·路斯(Adolf Loos)的建筑理念。这次游学极大地扩展了他的视野，使他接触到当时最先进的建筑思想和工程技术，为他后来的现代主义建筑理念奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Le Corbusier embarked on a four-year educational tour across Europe, visiting Paris, Berlin, Vienna, and Prague. In Paris, he studied reinforced concrete techniques under Auguste Perret; in Berlin, he met Peter Behrens, where he encountered Walter Gropius and Mies van der Rohe; in Vienna, he was exposed to Adolf Loos' architectural philosophy. These travels significantly expanded his horizons, exposing him to the most advanced architectural ideas and engineering techniques of the time, laying the foundation for his later modernist architectural concepts.

points.title: 先锋实践
points.description: 勒·柯布西耶移居巴黎，开始了他的先锋实践时期。他与画家阿梅德·奥赞方(Amedee Ozenfant)创立了纯粹主义(Purism)艺术运动，提出绘画应回归基本几何形状和纯粹形式。1922年，他在巴黎开设了自己的建筑事务所，与表兄皮埃尔·让纳雷(Pierre Jeanneret)合作。这一时期，他设计了一系列具有革命性的住宅项目，如库克别墅(Villa Cook)和斯坦别墅(Villa Stein)，并发表了《走向新建筑》(Vers une architecture)等重要著作，提出了'住宅是居住的机器'等标志性理念，奠定了现代主义建筑的理论基础。
points.descriptionEn: Moving to Paris, Le Corbusier began his avant-garde practice period. He co-founded the Purist art movement with painter Amedee Ozenfant, advocating for a return to basic geometric forms and pure representation in painting. In 1922, he opened his own architectural office in collaboration with his cousin Pierre Jeanneret. During this time, he designed a series of revolutionary residential projects such as Villa Cook and Villa Stein, and published seminal works like 'Vers une architecture' (Towards a New Architecture), proposing iconic concepts like 'a house is a machine for living in,' establishing the theoretical foundation of modernist architecture.

points.title: 理论成型
points.description: 这一时期勒·柯布西耶的理论体系逐渐成型。他提出了著名的'现代建筑五点'：底层架空、自由平面、自由立面、水平长窗、屋顶花园。1929年，他设计了萨伏伊别墅(Villa Savoye)，成为现代主义建筑的里程碑作品。1931年，他受邀参与设计莫斯科的苏维宫项目，虽然最终未能建成，但这一经历深化了他对大规模城市设计的思考。1933年，他参与国际现代建筑协会(CIAM)会议，提出'光辉城市'(Ville Radieuse)概念，规划了功能分区明确的理想城市模型。二战期间，他大部分时间留在维希法国，继续从事绘画和写作，完成了《模度》(Modulor)等著作。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Le Corbusier's theoretical system took shape. He formulated his famous 'Five Points of Architecture': pilotis, free plan, free facade, ribbon window, and roof garden. In 1929, he designed Villa Savoye, a landmark of modernist architecture. In 1931, he was invited to design the Soviet Palace in Moscow, which was never built but deepened his thinking on large-scale urban design. In 1933, he participated in the CIAM conference, proposing the 'Ville Radieuse' concept with an ideal urban model of functional zoning. During WWII, he mostly remained in Vichy France, continuing his painting and writing, completing works like 'The Modulor'.

points.title: 战后重建
points.description: 二战后，勒·柯布西耶积极参与城市重建工作。1945年，他提出'马赛公寓'(Unité d'Habitation)概念，这是一种集合住宅模式，旨在解决战后住房短缺问题。1952年，马赛公寓建成，成为现代主义居住建筑的典范。同时，他继续完善他的'光辉城市'理论，设计了印度昌迪加尔(Chandigarh)的城市规划，这是他大规模城市规划理念的实践。在法国，他设计了马赛公寓、拉图雷特修道院(La Tourette)等标志性建筑，这些建筑体现了他对钢筋混凝土、模数化设计和光影效果的独特运用。
points.descriptionEn: After WWII, Le Corbusier actively participated in urban reconstruction. In 1945, he proposed the 'Unité d'Habitation' concept, a housing model designed to address post-war housing shortages. The Marseille Unité was completed in 1952, becoming a典范 of modernist residential architecture. Concurrently, he continued developing his 'Ville Radieuse' theory and designed the urban plan for Chandigarh, India, putting his large-scale urban planning concepts into practice. In France, he designed iconic buildings like the Marseille Unité and La Tourette Monastery, showcasing his unique use of reinforced concrete, modular design, and play of light and shadow.

points.title: 晚期杰作
points.description: 勒·柯布西耶晚年创作了一系列杰作，包括朗香教堂(Notre Dame du Haut, Ronchamp,1955)、拉图雷特修道院(1960)和萨伏伊别墅的改造项目。这些建筑展现了他对自然光线、空间体验和象征性形式的探索，标志着他从纯粹的功能主义向更具表现性、雕塑性的风格转变。1961年，他获得美国建筑师学会金质奖章，1963年获得英国皇家建筑师学会皇家金质奖章。1965年，他在法国南部地中海沿岸游泳时因心脏病发作去世，享年78岁。他的去世标志着现代主义建筑一个重要时代的结束，但他的思想和作品至今仍对全球建筑产生深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Le Corbusier created a series of masterpieces including Notre Dame du Haut (Ronchamp, 1955), La Tourette Monastery (1960), and modifications to the Villa Savoye. These works showcased his exploration of natural light, spatial experience, and symbolic forms, marking a shift from pure functionalism to a more expressive, sculptural style. In 1961, he received the AIA Gold Medal, and in 1963, the RIBA Royal Gold Medal. In 1965, he died of a heart attack while swimming in the Mediterranean coast of southern France at age 78. His death marked the end of an important era in modernist architecture, but his ideas and works continue to influence global architecture to this day.

appraisal.zh: 勒·柯布西耶被公认为现代建筑之父，其「建筑五点」与模度系统为工业化时代的居住问题提供了理性方案，马赛公寓与昌迪加尔规划体现了他对居住理想的执着。不过也有研究者指出，他的城市规划过于机械，大规模住宅缺乏社区温度，「住宅是机器」之说简化了人的需求，其与威权政权的合作亦受质疑。总体而言，他的遗产复杂而矛盾，既是现代建筑的分水岭，也持续引发关于城市与人性的思考。
appraisal.en: Le Corbusier is widely regarded as the father of modern architecture: his Five Points and Modulor system offered rational solutions to industrial-age housing, and works such as the Unité d'Habitation and Chandigarh embody his idealistic pursuit of better living. Yet researchers also note that his urban planning was mechanistic, that large-scale housing lacked community warmth, and that 'a house is a machine for living' oversimplified human needs; his work for authoritarian regimes has likewise drawn scrutiny. His legacy is complex and contradictory—a watershed that still provokes debate over cities and humanity.

supporter.zh: 勒·柯布西耶被誉为现代建筑之父，他的革命性理念彻底改变了20世纪的城市面貌和建筑语言。支持者认为他通过'建筑五点'和模度系统，为建筑提供了科学理性的设计方法，解决了工业化时代的居住问题。他的作品如马赛公寓和昌迪加尔城市规划，体现了对社会问题的深刻关怀和对人类居住环境的理想主义追求。他的建筑美学强调功能与形式的统一，以及对光线、空间和材料的精妙运用，为现代建筑开辟了新的可能性。
supporter.en: Le Corbusier is hailed as the father of modern architecture, and his revolutionary ideas fundamentally transformed the urban landscape and architectural language of the 20th century. Supporters argue that through his 'Five Points of Architecture' and Modulor system, he provided scientific and rational design methods for architecture, addressing housing problems in the industrial age. His works like the Unité d'Habitation and Chandigarh urban plan demonstrate profound concern for social issues and an idealistic pursuit of human living environments. His architectural aesthetic emphasizes the unity of function and form, and the masterful use of light, space, and materials, opening new possibilities for modern architecture.

critic.zh: 批评者指出勒·柯布西耶的城市规划理念过于理想化和机械化，忽视了城市生活的复杂性和人文关怀。他的'光辉城市'和大规模住宅项目虽然解决了功能问题，但往往缺乏社区感和人文温度，导致了许多社会问题。他的建筑美学有时被批评为冷酷无情，忽视了地域文化和历史文脉。此外，他与威权政权的合作，如为印度尼赫鲁和法国政府设计项目，也引发了对政治立场的质疑。他的'住宅是机器'的理念被批评为过度简化了人类居住的复杂需求。
critic.en: Critics point out that Le Corbusier's urban planning concepts were overly idealistic and mechanistic, neglecting the complexity of urban life and human关怀. His 'Ville Radieuse' and large-scale housing projects, while solving functional problems, often lacked community spirit and human warmth, leading to social issues. His architectural aesthetic has been criticized as cold and indifferent, neglecting regional culture and historical context. Additionally, his collaborations with authoritarian regimes, such as designing projects for Nehru in India and the French government, have raised questions about his political stance. His concept of 'a house is a machine for living' has been criticized for oversimplifying the complex needs of human habitation.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，勒·柯布西耶已成为现代主义建筑的标志性人物，其影响远超建筑领域本身。他的作品和思想被广泛讨论、模仿和批判，成为现代建筑史上的分水岭。在流行文化中，他的形象常与理性、进步和乌托邦理想联系在一起，同时也代表着现代主义与人性、传统之间的张力。他的建筑作品已成为文化符号，吸引无数建筑爱好者朝圣。历史学界认为，勒·柯布西耶的遗产是复杂而矛盾的，他既推动了建筑技术的进步，也留下了关于城市与人性的深刻思考，其影响持续塑造着我们对建筑和城市的理解。
objective.en: From a historical and pop culture perspective, Le Corbusier has become an iconic figure in modern architecture, whose influence extends far beyond the architectural field itself. His works and ideas have been widely discussed, imitated, and criticized, marking a watershed in architectural history. In popular culture, his image is often associated with rationality, progress, and utopian ideals, while also representing the tension between modernism and humanity, tradition. His architectural works have become cultural symbols, attracting countless architecture enthusiasts on pilgrimages. Historiography views Le Corbusier's legacy as complex and contradictory; he both advanced architectural technology and left profound reflections on cities and humanity, with his influence continuing to shape our understanding of architecture and urban spaces.

self.zh: 建筑是光线的巧妙、正确的和宏伟的游戏。
self.en: Architecture is the masterly, correct and magnificent play of masses brought together in light.
